_note: Canonical decision queue for the V2 planning layer (D-044). Status and ownership come from these fields only; PENDING_DECISIONS.md is generated from them. Accepted decisions also get a row in v2/DECISIONS.md.

records.title: Approve the nine V2 phase milestone target dates
records.required_action: Confirm, revise or leave UNSCHEDULED each proposed date in v2/planning/milestones.json; state whether they are planning targets or commitments.

records.title: Define P6 LAB & ROBOT reopening criteria
records.required_action: Say who can reopen mechanical work, what safety and mechanical readiness evidence is required, and whether P7 and P8 physical acceptance depend on V2-M6.

records.title: Decide where Sim, SDK, Studio and Control Plane live
records.required_action: Name which are separate repositories, which live inside another repository, and which are planned. Until then no pipeline entry exists for them.

records.title: Approve the repository and task ID registry
records.required_action: Confirm the prefixes in repo-pipeline.json (KOS-SENSE, KOS-MOTION, KOS-MIND, KOS-SKILL and the existing ones) and that task IDs are globally unique.

records.title: Approve the acceptance and test policy
records.required_action: Set required checks per repository kind, coverage thresholds if any, waiver authority and safety and security approval roles (v2/planning/ACCEPTANCE_STANDARD.md).

records.title: Approve the tag policy
records.required_action: Confirm annotated SemVer tags, the restricted use of milestone prerelease tags and who may create release tags.

records.title: Approve the PR reviewer-role mapping
records.required_action: Name holders for ARCHITECTURE_REVIEWER and SAFETY_REVIEWER, which are not recorded; PROGRAM_OWNER, REPO_CODE_OWNER and SECURITY_OWNER are Dinesh today.

records.title: Reconcile the 4.5 PM effort difference
records.required_action: Remaining workstream estimates sum to 170.5 PM against the 175 PM planning reference. Keep UNALLOCATED, or assign to contingency, overhead or omitted work.

records.title: Approve the status schema and record ownership
records.required_action: Confirm the canonical locations of decision, review, gate and milestone records in v2/planning and the generated report locations.

records.title: Choose the merge method
records.required_action: The pipeline manifest says merge commit, matching history; ChatGPT proposed squash so the Task footer is in the final protected-branch commit. Decide before enforcing the Task footer.

records.title: Confirm team capacity for the 12-month horizon
records.required_action: 170.5 to 175 PM remaining over about 11.9 months needs roughly 14 to 15 person-months of effort per calendar month. State the real capacity so dates can be derived from effort.

records.title: Include the four new repositories in the return-to-private plan and readiness checklist
records.required_action: They are not in repo_readiness.json or D-037. Decide their target visibility and add them.

records.title: Choose the licence for the four new repositories
records.required_action: They carry Apache-2.0 from creation; Core and Community are Apache-2.0, RaaS and the program repository are proprietary. Decide before any code is added.

records.title: Register the four new repositories on their workstreams
records.required_action: workstreams.json has SENSE, MOTION, SKILL and MIND with no repository. Recording the repository changes a program record, so it needs your approval (as D-034 did for the actuators).

records.title: Approve drafting the Core engineering contract
records.required_action: Needed to close contract_pin: contract text, exact SHA and SHA-256, a Core pin file and a CI check.

records.title: Answer the RaaS SEC-GATE-001 questions
records.required_action: Was kritva:kritva ever a real credential, must it be rotated, and what is the disposition deadline.

records.title: Test the Community security mailbox
records.required_action: After the SECURITY.md contact patch merges, send a test email to dinesh@kritvaos.in so security_policy can move from OPEN to ATTESTED.

records.title: Make pr-acceptance-gate a required check in each repo ruleset
records.required_action: After the gate workflow has run once on a PR in each repo, add pr-acceptance-gate to the required status checks of the main ruleset (GitHub settings, owner action). The gate is report-only: REJECT blocks merge, NEEDS_HUMAN and APPROVE do not. Rollout to the other nine repos follows once the gate has run on the four new repos.
